purpose: Fixed-seed search and controller evaluation with paired uncertainty intervals and measured adapter costs.
policy: No controller, search, uncertainty-bound or service-threshold tuning using these results. Retain all seeds, no-hit runs and physically unattainable cases. These previously inspected cases use known small feeder models, not an external blind holdout.
metrics: Paired capped first-failure trials (no hit = budget+1), hit rate, measured electrical-adapter solve calls, search runtime, separately budgeted reduction and strict replay. Controller results retain all-case and initially-feasible/truth-attainable denominators. Bootstrap resamples whole paired seeds, never individual correlated trials. Intervals describe this sampling protocol, not field risk.
implementation_pin_reason: Shared replay comparator rejects non-finite values and Boolean/numeric type mismatches. Electrical models, cases, seeds, budgets, variants, tolerances and analysis settings unchanged; actual rerun under new source.
